business_description: Key Maker & Locksmith | Electronic City is a 24-hour key making and locksmith shop on Gollahalli Main Road, Siraj Layout, Electronic City Phase 1, Bengaluru. We duplicate keys for homes, offices and shops, make keys for compatible cars and bikes, and provide lock repair, lock replacement and lockout assistance. We also offer compatible car chip and remote programming, key fobs, remote shell replacement, rekeying, safe opening and window-lock work. Visit the shop or ask about on-site service across our listed areas. Contact us with your key, lock or vehicle details and exact location to confirm compatibility, availability and a quote. Cash, UPI, IMPS and NEFT are accepted.
